items.title: Trade, Iran and Taiwan on the agenda as Trump arrives in China for high-stakes talks with Xi
items.description: The US president says his first request to Xi would be to  "open up" China, while Beijing is expected to press Trump on the status of Taiwan.

items.title: Former Nigerian minister sentenced to 75 years in rare corruption verdict
items.description: Former Power Minister Saleh Mamman was convicted last week - but the authorities do not know his whereabouts.

items.title: Latvian PM resigns after row over stray Ukrainian drones
items.description: Drones bound for Russia crashed down in Latvia last week, prompting a political fallout.

items.title: Rescuers pull dead from rubble of Kyiv flats after massive Russian strikes
items.description: A girl, 12, is among the dead after Russia launched attacks across Ukraine overnight, officials say.

items.title: Court overturns Alex Murdaugh's murder convictions and orders new trial
items.description: The court has ordered a new trial over the June 2021 killings of Paul and Maggie Murdaugh.

items.title: 'They shot my neighbour in the head' - the lakeside city traumatised by war
items.description: Rebel fighters and Rwandan troops are accused of committing atrocities after capturing the DR Congo city of Uvira in December.

items.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanon kill 22 people, health ministry says
items.description: Eight children are among those reported dead after a series of air strikes hit the south of Beirut.

items.title: Cuba has run out of diesel and oil, energy minister says
items.description: The minister says the situation in Cuba is "extremely tense", as a US-led blockade of oil to the country causes widespread power cuts.

items.title: Gunshots fired in Philippine Senate where lawmaker wanted by ICC is holed up
items.description: Senator Ronald dela Rosa, a former police chief, enforced former President Rodrigo Duterte's deadly drug war.

items.title: Woman isolating on British island in South Pacific after hantavirus contact
items.description: The woman who was on a virus-hit ship shows "no signs of illness", the government of Pitcairn Islands, a British Overseas Territory, says.

items.title: Dozens of dogs rescued and suspect arrested in Uganda after BBC investigation
items.description: A BBC investigation exposed how scammers posted social content of dogs in distress to dupe donors into giving money.

items.title: Epstein abused me while under house arrest, survivor tells US lawmakers
items.description: Roza was among several victims who gave testimony to Democratic lawmakers on Tuesday.
